typescript_policy.authored: ui/tsconfig.json: strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes on authored source and generated files except the Hey API client runtime. skipLibCheck for third-party .d.ts only. Tooling configs are a separate composite project (ui/tsconfig.tooling.json) with types:[bun]. ui/tests is type-checked via ui/tsconfig.tests.json referenced from ui/tsconfig.json.
typescript_policy.generated_client_runtime: ui/tsconfig.generated.json: client/ and core/ only; exactOptionalPropertyTypes false (hey-api/openapi-ts#3157). Removal probe: typecheck:generated-strict.
typescript_policy.wire_validation_boundary: Host/tool payloads validated with generated Zod schemas keep z.infer/z.output (equivalent in Zod 4) in authored UI. types.gen remains the HTTP-client shape. At a real SDK/wire boundary, construct the generated request object explicitly and omit undefined optionals once in main.tsx. No cast through unknown in ui/src; RulesForm tests mount the form and assert displayed AJV errors.
typescript_policy.node_ambient: No MCP Apps Node-types island. Buffer appears only in @modelcontextprotocol/client .d.ts; skipLibCheck covers it. @types/node is not a direct dependency.

typescript_boundary_fixes: Feature components that consume Zod-parsed tool results take z.infer<typeof z…> instead of types.gen (exactOptionalPropertyTypes). Zod 4 treats z.infer and z.output as equivalent; no respelling.
RulesForm uses customizeValidator<NamingRules>() and Form<NamingRules> from @rjsf/validator-ajv8.

enforced_by.check: Actual pinned generators and consumers, every feature

phase_0.covers: On every push the foundation job runs the pinned generators twice from the committed lockfiles and requires both passes and the checkout to agree byte for byte; it then requires the workspace to format, pass strict Clippy and the source policy, pass every crate's tests with every feature, and the UI to lint, build, type-check and pass its unit tests. It does not prove a library qualification, any behaviour against a running server, or dependency advisories: the audit job runs on main, nightly and on dispatch and is not a required check.

A pass proves that every criterion pinned in qualification/docling/criteria.json passed, or is not applicable by design with the reason stated in the receipt, for the Docling crate Cargo.lock pins, called directly as a library on the clean commit the receipt cites: the model assets have the manifest's hashes and are the files the library loads; every fixture converts, is recognised as its declared format and holds the content SOURCES.json declares, and a fixture without glyphs yields no invented text; each PDF and image fixture has one render per page that is not a flat colour unless the page is declared blank, and a page and a box for every text item, table and picture; a truncated PDF is refused; a 1 ms budget is reported and changes the result; and a peak memory was read for every converter process. It does not prove a locator for DOCX items (the library gives none) or for XLSX and PPTX items (recorded without a rule and not pinned), the production ingest worker, a memory limit (peak memory is measured, never limited) or a conversion through the application.

A pass proves that every criterion pinned in qualification/mcp-apps/criteria.json was judged and passed on the clean commit the receipt cites: the App bundle built in the run is one HTML resource with the SDK's MIME type and a production React build; a fixture MCP server (the harness, answering from committed fixtures) lists and serves that resource, the four render tools and the app-only show and read_object over Streamable HTTP, with read_object declared by the product's schemas, served in ranged blocks that hash to the dataset's digest, and refusing an unknown digest or argument; and in the ext-apps basic-host example under Chromium each of the four views shows its own text with no alert and no serious or critical axe violation in the App frame, the present view drawing its chart and tables from the dataset it fetched. It does not prove the product server's show and read_object handlers or its blob store, rendering in claude.ai or ChatGPT (the acceptance gate mcp-apps-web-hosts) or the production MCP server over the Application.

phase_0.covers: Every CI run starts from a fresh clone of the pushed commit: bootstrap installs from the committed lockfiles only, builds the generator, generates, and builds and type-checks the UI before the gated steps run, so nothing can depend on an uncommitted file. Cargo's registry and target directory and Bun's cache are restored from caches keyed on the lockfiles, and CI neither asserts that the tree is still clean afterwards nor runs the audit; `bun scripts/dev.mjs clean-checkout` does both locally and is a tool, not a gate.

enforced_by.check: Dependency-free source tooling, not product acceptance

phase_0.covers: Every push runs the dependency-free offline suite in a fresh clone with nothing installed but Bun. The ruleset on main requires this check and "Actual pinned generators and consumers, every feature" (the deterministic-foundation gate), so a commit reaches main only with both green; the lane and audit jobs are not required checks.

construction.meaning: VersionStore (trailer, find_commit: commit is idempotent on MutationId, candidates), BlobStore, WorkspaceCatalog, SQLite stores (Record/Mutation/Draft/Confirmation/SandboxCapability/Proposal/Upload/Event/Credential), SearchIndex (no drafts), local AccessControl
Commit succeeds, mutation complete is never written, retry finds the revision through find_commit and creates no second commit (commit is idempotent on MutationId)
A superseded attempt can neither complete nor release the mutation; both takeover orders are exercised
A confirmation cannot be consumed twice, or for a different revision, digest, action or target
Two editors on one item get independent drafts; the second Snapshot conflicts after the first
Production ingest worker hard memory bound; not DOCLING_RS_MAX_MEMORY_MB on DocumentConverter

construction.meaning: Kill and restart against the real RecordStore with JobHandler(&ClaimedJob); no duplicate effect; after restart leases are expired and pending jobs re-enqueued (`expire_leases`, `pending_jobs`); an attempt that dies without a restart is retried after its lease expires.
